meta.title: Whale Sentinel
meta.description: Whale Sentinel (小鲸哨): a lightweight DSH task radar. Collapsed, the mascot sits at her desk; once the panel opens she stands beside it, gripping the edge and pointing at the tasks. Collapsed and expanded sizes are adjustable independently, in-page notices survive hiding the mascot, and foreground system notifications are optional. Failed reminders retry, a missing click bridge degrades to notification-only, and a corrupt settings file falls back to safe defaults. Does not modify the DSH core.
